findings.text: Exposes a kernel virtual range read operation that copies mapped contents into a caller iterator while zero filling gaps, returning the portion of the request accounted for including holes. It tolerates ranges that start or end outside any live area.

Exposes a service that maps pages from an existing kernel virtual allocation into a user mapping at page granularity, plus a convenience wrapper that maps the whole destination range using its own bounds and a caller page offset.

Exposes paired group allocation and release operations that reserve several kernel virtual ranges sharing one base so caller relative offsets stay intact, returning an array of descriptors on success and releasing each entry plus the array on free.
Exposes pressure notification, pressure grade computation, and per-group initialization operations that turn reclaim scan versus reclaim success observations into a low medium critical signal.

A range read skips areas that have neither an owning descriptor nor allocation flags and skips descriptors still marked uninitialized, advancing to the next live area without producing mapped bytes for the skipped extent.

A range read sizes owned allocation style mappings from their page count when available and otherwise from the owning descriptor or area extent, routes RAM style areas and ordinary mapped memory through distinct copy paths, and treats IO style or sparse mappings as holes filled with zeros.

Remapping validates that page offset shifting and length addition do not overflow, that both ends are page aligned, that the source exists and carries a user mappable or coherent attribute, and that the requested slice stays within the source size; on success it marks the destination against expansion and dumping.

Group reservation requires power of two page aligned granularity, aligned offsets and sizes, and pairwise non overlapping caller extents, rejects layouts whose highest end cannot fit between the allowed start and end, and searches from the top for a shared base where every member fits inside free extents.

Free space lookup converts tree nodes to areas safely, finds the free extent enclosing an address by descending the ordered tree while remembering the best lower start candidate, and derives an aligned candidate end by walking the free list backward bounded by the allowed end.
Early free space is built as the complement of preexisting busy entries across the full address span, inserting a free extent before each busy entry and after the last one when the gap is positive.

Node layer setup prepares per-node busy and lazy structures plus fixed size pools and their locks, using a single node by default and a bounded larger count scaled by possible CPUs on wide systems with a fixed zone size.

Boot initialization creates the area cache, prepares per-CPU block queues and deferred release state, imports each preexisting busy entry into its owning node busy structure, then builds free space and marks the subsystem ready before registering a shrinker for pooled areas.

Pool size reporting sums cached free extents across all nodes and pools and reports empty when zero, while scanning takes the purge mutex and asks each node to decay its pool, then stops further scanning in that pass.

Diagnostic reporting lists busy RAM extents and owned mappings with bounds, size, caller, page count, physical address and attribute tags, appends per-node page distribution when NUMA support is enabled, skips uninitialized entries with an ordering barrier, and finally lists unpurged lazy extents.

Pressure accounting returns early when grouping is disabled, when the hierarchy versus tree combination has no consumer, when the allocation mask lacks any counted attribute, when nothing was scanned, and for root or absent groups in the non-tree branch.

Pressure grade is derived from the fraction of scanned pages not reclaimed scaled to percent, with fully reclaimed or oversubscribed samples yielding zero pressure, then mapped to low below the medium threshold, medium below the critical threshold, and critical at or above it.
Pressure state initialization prepares the per-group accumulation lock and delegates remaining setup to version one state.

Traversal and insertion over a node busy structure hold that node busy spin protection while dereferencing the current area or list, release before looking up the next node, and release on every early exit including finished and hole-only paths.

Group reservation holds the global free space spin protection across the whole top-down search and carve phase and across rollback that merges partially carved extents back, releasing before populating shadow state and before inserting into busy structures.

Unpurged reporting holds each node lazy spin protection while walking its lazy list, non-tree pressure accumulation holds a per-group spin protection while updating and testing the window counters, and pool decay scanning holds the purge mutex across all nodes.

Observed kernel virtual area state carries a start and end bound, an owning descriptor pointer, flags, and tree plus list linkage; the owning descriptor carries address, size, flags, caller, page count, physical address, page array pointer, and next linkage for the early list.

Observed per-node state groups a busy tree list and lock, a lazy tree list and lock, an array of fixed size pools each with list and length, and a pool lock; global state includes free tree and list, node array and count, zone size, readiness flag, area cache, and purge mutex.

Group reservation moves through validate, allocate descriptors, lock and search for a shared base, carve each member, unlock, populate shadow, insert busy and mark accessible; on search exhaustion or carve inconsistency it unlocks, optionally reclaims and retries once, otherwise merges back partial work and releases descriptors, with a separate shadow failure path that merges everything back under lock.

Non-tree pressure accumulates scanned and reclaimed counts until the window is reached, then resets both counters and evaluates the grade; only grades above low for orders at or below the costly threshold assert socket pressure with hysteresis, otherwise the sample is dropped.

Boot time setup, proc file creation, proc sequential display, and shrinker count versus scan callbacks form the visible entry surface for initialization, human readable diagnostics, and memory pressure driven pool reclamation.

Caller address plus length overflow is clamped to the address space end, page offset shifts and size additions are checked for arithmetic overflow, and misaligned addresses or granularities are rejected rather than rounded.

Reading a descriptor whose uninitialized mark may clear concurrently uses an ordering barrier paired with the clearer, carve-time inconsistencies trigger warnings plus merge-back recovery instead of proceeding, and shadow release is expected to tolerate regions that were never successfully populated.

Pressure window equals sixteen times the swap cluster maximum, medium threshold is sixty, critical threshold is ninety five, and non-tree evaluation waits until accumulated scanned pages reach the window.

Diagnostic file identity is a fixed name vmallocinfo with owner read-only permission, node layer bounds to one hundred twenty eight with a sixteen page zone unit, and the fallback header defines a guard macro plus no-op init and unmap operations with the range map operation reporting invalid argument.
